newsitem.title: USA: CIBER Inc applies for NYSE listing.
newsitem.headline: CIBER Inc applies for NYSE listing.

text.p: CIBER Inc said on Friday it applied for listing of its common stock on the New York Stock Exchange.

The company expects its shares to begin trading on the NYSE the following week under the symbol "CBR". CIBER has traded on the Nasdaq National Market System under the symbol "CIBR" since the completion of its initial public offering on March 14 1994.
Once the stock is listed on the NYSE, CIBER will delist its shares from NASDAQ.
CIBER provides information technology consulting services.
